Function reference

Build the detection field

Fit the detection curve to your range test, measure distances through water, and give every water cell a detection probability for every receiver.

range_test_counts()
Count range-test detections per receiver, range-test tag and hour
de_logistic()
A logistic detection curve from two distances
de_model()
A detection model for positioning
water_distances()
Distances through water from receivers to every water cell
de_field()
Detection probability from every water cell to every receiver
system_de()
Detection probability of the whole array, per listening day
plot(<de_model>) plot(<de_field>)
Plot a detection model or a detection field

Position the animals

Count detections per animal and hour, turn the counts into location surfaces, and draw regions and samples from them.

bin_detections()
Count detections per animal, time bin and receiver
location_surface()
Location surfaces from detection counts
credible_region()
Credible regions of location surfaces
sample_locations()
Draw locations from location surfaces
plot(<loc_surface>)
Map one location surface

Used and available points

Draw availability points from the array’s detection surface, matched to the presence draws, and stack used and available points with covariates for a habitat-selection model of your choice.

sample_available()
Draw availability points from the detection surface
used_available()
Stack used and available points for a habitat-selection model

Figures

The theme, the depth and probability scales, the receiver rings and the map scale bar positionR figures are drawn with.

theme_positionr()
The positionR figure theme
positionr_ring_colours()
Receiver ring colours of the positionR maps
layer_receivers()
Receivers as rings on a map
annotation_scale_bar()
Scale bar for a map
scale_fill_depth()
Depth scale for a map
scale_fill_probability()
Probability scale for a map

Example data

The Stoney Lake study every page runs on: 70 receivers, five animals with known tracks, and the range tests of its range model.

stoney_track
Five simulated animals in Stoney Lake with known tracks
stoney_selection
A simulated habitat-selection study on Stoney Lake
stoney_range_test
A simulated range test of the Stoney Lake range model
stoney_range_covariates
A simulated range test with two tag models, two depths and daily wind
